criteria.requirement: Apply the listed-issuer policy regime, not an all-SA rule.
criteria.pass: Explains why this Luxembourg listed SA is subject to the shareholder remuneration-policy vote.
criteria.fail: Treats the listed-company rule as universal to private SAs or says the issuer need not hold a policy vote.

sourceRefs.quote: Les sociétés doivent établir une politique de rémunération

factRefs.quote: a Luxembourg SA whose shares are admitted to trading on an EU regulated market

criteria.minimalPass: Listed Luxembourg SA: put a remuneration policy to the AGM vote.
criteria.nearMiss: Every SA must get a binding vote before paying any director.

criteria.requirement: Distinguish default consultative vote from binding articles.
criteria.pass: Recognizes ordinarily consultative policy vote but applies Article 19's binding override to Ardenne.
criteria.fail: Treats the CFO's advisory-vote theory as authorization to pay the rejected package.

sourceRefs.quote: Le vote des actionnaires sur la politique de rémunération lors de l’assemblée générale est consultatif.
Toutefois les statuts peuvent prévoir que le vote sur la politique de rémunération exprimé lors de l’assemblée générale est contraignant.

factRefs.quote: The shareholders' vote on the remuneration policy is binding.

criteria.minimalPass: Although normally advisory, the articles make Ardenne's policy vote binding.
criteria.nearMiss: The rejection is merely advisory despite Article 19.

criteria.requirement: Give a component-specific October payroll instruction.
criteria.pass: Blocks EUR 35,000/month new fixed pay and EUR 180,000 bonus; permits only remuneration conforming to existing approved 2022 policy, including EUR 25,000/month fixed pay, pending a valid new policy.
criteria.fail: Greenlights the rejected package or blocks all compensation despite the surviving approved policy.

sourceRefs.quote: la société doit continuer à rémunérer ses dirigeants

factRefs.quote: The 2022 policy was approved at the 30 June 2022 AGM.

criteria.minimalPass: Pay only the existing approved-policy EUR 25,000 monthly fixed amount; hold the EUR 35,000 rate and bonus.
criteria.nearMiss: Because shareholders rejected the new policy, stop even compliant old fixed pay.

criteria.requirement: Address failed-policy cure and material revision timing.
criteria.pass: Instructs board to submit revised policy for approval at next AGM (or an earlier valid general meeting) and explains significant change triggers a new vote; ordinary four-year cadence does not excuse this rejection.
criteria.fail: Says wait four years or that the September rejected text governs meanwhile.

sourceRefs.quote: lors de chaque modification importante et, en tout état de cause, au moins tous les quatre ans

factRefs.quote: The next AGM is scheduled for 20 April 2027

criteria.minimalPass: Submit a revised policy at the next general meeting, earlier if new terms cannot wait; material changes require a vote, and the four-year outer interval does not excuse the rejection.
criteria.nearMiss: The company may defer the rejected policy until June 2030 without a new vote.

criteria.pass: Finds the current policy lacks required procedural terms and identified derogable elements; retention urgency alone is not a free-standing exception and cannot rescue the proposed bonus.
criteria.fail: Authorizes the bonus merely by calling it retention/emergency.

sourceRefs.quote: à condition que cette politique prévoie les conditions procédurales

factRefs.quote: no exceptional-deviation procedure or list of derogable elements

criteria.minimalPass: Do not invoke an exception absent policy procedures and specified derogable items.
criteria.nearMiss: The board can approve any emergency retention bonus without policy wording.

criteria.requirement: Distinguish report vote from policy vote and identify 2026 reporting action.
criteria.pass: Identifies the annual report vote as consultative, requires next report to explain response to its negative 2025 vote, and starts preparing individualized component/policy-compliance reporting rather than using that vote to validate future pay.
criteria.fail: Calls the report vote binding approval of the new 2026 package or omits response to prior negative vote.

sourceRefs.quote: L’assemblée générale annuelle dispose du droit de procéder à un vote consultatif sur le rapport sur la rémunération
La société explique, dans le rapport sur la rémunération suivant, la manière dont le vote de l’assemblée générale a été pris en compte.

factRefs.quote: a negative advisory vote on the 2025 remuneration report

criteria.minimalPass: The report vote is distinct and consultative; the next report explains the negative 2025 vote and itemizes each director's actual remuneration components and compliance with the voted policy, rather than validating future pay.
criteria.nearMiss: A negative report vote itself invalidates the 2022 policy.

criteria.pass: Instructs posting the policy and 18 September vote date/result on issuer website without delay and keeping the policy available during application.
criteria.fail: Treats the existing 2022 policy page alone as sufficient disclosure of the September vote.

sourceRefs.quote: la politique de rémunération, ainsi que la date et le résultat du vote, doivent être rendus publics sans retard sur le site internet de la société

factRefs.quote: has not posted the proposed 2026 policy, the date or the result of the 18 September vote

criteria.minimalPass: Post the voted policy plus date and rejection result without delay; keep the applicable policy available.
criteria.nearMiss: Publish only once the April 2027 AGM approves a policy.

criteria.requirement: Make revised policy content operational, not just an agenda item.
criteria.pass: Calls for clear fixed/variable component and bonus terms, performance criteria and decision/conflict process, plus explanation of significant revisions and prior shareholder feedback before re-vote.
criteria.fail: Recommends resubmitting identical text with no identified required policy contents or feedback treatment.

sourceRefs.quote: doit décrire les différentes composantes de la rémunération fixe et variable
doit indiquer la manière dont elle prend en compte les votes et les avis des actionnaires

factRefs.quote: increases fixed CEO pay to EUR 420,000 and adds a EUR 180,000 signing bonus

criteria.minimalPass: Revise fixed/bonus components with performance criteria, a decision and conflict-management process, and explanation of changes and shareholder feedback before a new vote.
criteria.nearMiss: Simply retable the rejected bonus schedule as a board resolution.
